next_item_hypothesis: Demonstrated failure: content-only item codes may merge distinct successors of an anchor into indistinguishable first-level neighborhoods despite train-only directed transitions: 314605 of 339519 transitions have no observed reverse event (0.9266197178950221), and mean next-item entropy is 4.844072338042215 bits. Hypothesis: negative curvature better represents branching, non-reversible successor neighborhoods than a flat metric, improving hierarchical item codes and ultimately Stage3 next-item ranking. These observations do not establish causality or curvature necessity. Stage2 builds one global three-token SID per item from content and does not rank or use user context.

math_definition.builder: For each item i, fixed content embedding e_i maps through the same frozen encoder f_theta to z_i in R^32. Set r_i^(1)=z_i. At each level j=1,2,3 perform in exact order: MAP residual r_i^(j) -> PROJECT u_i^(j)=P_R(r_i^(j)) -> ASSIGN k_ij=argmin over k in 1..256 of D_c^2(u_i^(j),P_R(q_jk)) -> SUBTRACT r_i^(j+1)=r_i^(j)-q_j,k_ij. The subtraction result is not projected until the next level's MAP then projection. Code vectors are constrained by projection after every optimizer update. Level 2 conditions exactly on k_i1 through its residual; level 3 conditions exactly on k_i1 and k_i2 through its residual. SID=(k_i1,k_i2,k_i3), globally shared for each item.

geometry.shared_map: P_R(x)=x*min(1,R/||x||), P_R(0)=0, R=0.99. It is identical and curvature-independent in both arms. Every vector entering a distance, including residual maps and code vectors, is projected to ||x||<=R.
geometry.clamp_domain_policy: For x != y, let t=2*c*||x-y||^2/((1-c*||x||^2)*(1-c*||y||^2)); evaluate arcosh(1+max(t,delta)) with frozen delta=1e-7. For exactly identical vectors return zero and bypass the clamp. At c=0 use the exact flat limit 4*||x-y||^2, with exact coincidence zero; the clamp is not applied to the flat formula. All scored vectors satisfy ||x||<=R=0.99; for c=0.1 this lies strictly inside the Poincare ball.
geometry.scored_distance: D^2(x,y)=d_c(x,y)^2=(1/c)*arcosh(1+2*c*||x-y||^2/((1-c*||x||^2)*(1-c*||y||^2)))^2. The objective and assignments use squared distance in both arms. Numerically stable arcosh(1+t)=log1p(t+sqrt(t*(t+2))) for t>=delta; exact coincidence bypasses clamp. As c->0, D^2 tends exactly to 4*||x-y||^2; unsquared distance tends to 2*||x-y||.
geometry.c_dependent_rules_and_limits: Only the scored distance depends on c; its c->0 limit is squared distance 4*||x-y||^2. No exponential map is used (identity if represented, whose limit is identity). The optional curvature projection radius (1-epsilon)/sqrt(c) is undefined at c=0 and is not used; the flat arm instead uses the same fixed P_R with R=0.99. Assignment, shared projection, residual mapping/subtraction and code constraints are c-independent.
geometry.flat_arm: One implementation parameterized by c=0.1 or c=0. The flat branch evaluates the exact squared-distance limit 4*||x-y||^2. Encoder, fixed projection, assignments, code parameters, residual subtraction, losses, initialization, optimizer, schedule, seeds, and budget are identical; no representation map changes with c. Only scored distance expression changes.

objective.anti_collapse: L_rec is the anti-collapse mechanism, with weight 1: each item's content-derived z_i must reconstruct from detached selected code vectors. Mapping every item to the same SID incurs content-dependent residual error and cannot erase this term.
loss_equations: For train item set I, B=|I|, z_i=f_theta(e_i), a_ij=stopgrad(q_j,k_ij), and xhat_i=sum(j=1..3) a_ij. L_rec=(1/B)*sum(i in I) D_c^2(P_R(z_i),P_R(xhat_i)). Arithmetic mean over I; empty I invalidates run.
L_commit=(1/(3B))*sum(i in I)sum(j=1..3) D_c^2(P_R(r_i^(j)),stopgrad(P_R(q_j,k_ij))). Arithmetic mean over item-level pairs; selected code target detached; empty I invalidates run.

Let T be multiset of adjacent item transitions from train split only. For each (a,b) in T choose n(a,b) as lowest-ID item in I excluding a,b; omit examples if no such item. T' is retained examples. With s_i=concat(onehot(k_i1),onehot(k_i2),onehot(k_i3)), L_trans=(1/|T'|)*sum((a,b) in T') max(0,1-cos(s_a,s_b)+cos(s_a,s_n(a,b))). Cosine norm denominator adds 1e-12. If T' empty, L_trans=0.
L=L_rec+0.25*L_commit+0.1*L_trans. Each term is normalized as stated; train transitions are legal assignment supervision, not Stage2 ranking.
objective.assignment_target_circularity: Current-parameter hard argmin indices are treated as nondifferentiable. Reconstruction selected-code vectors and commitment target code vectors are stop-gradient, so target gradients do not flow through their assignments or target vectors.

diagnostics.definitions: Use the frozen definitions verbatim: valid L1 positive hit rate over 52855 frozen validation pairs (one positive plus ten negatives per anchor, seed 42, history[-1] -> target), share whose anchor item's first SID token equals positive's first token; valid Hard-L1 ER=10*positive_hits/negative_hits with negatives counted identically; level2_distinct_prefixes=|{(k1,k2)}| over all items; L3 collision=share of items whose complete triple is shared by another; L3 refinement gain=mean item log2(|bucket(k1,k2)|/|bucket(k1,k2,k3)|); conditional G3 uses alpha=1,K=256, p_pref(l)=(number of items sharing target's level-two prefix with third code l, minus one only for target's own third code, plus alpha)/(bucket size minus one plus alpha*K); p_hist(l)=(train-only longest-prefix successor count of anchor restricted to successors sharing target's level-two prefix and third code l, plus alpha*p_pref(l))/(restricted successor total plus alpha); average log2(p_hist(target third code)/p_pref(target third code)); pair with no restricted successor contributes 0, non-finite pair NULL. No definition is changed.
diagnostics.validation_role: Diagnostics only. Validation pairs and behavior never enter fitting, target construction, assignments, or SID creation.

math_definition.null_outcome_rule: If any seed-wise or aggregated change is undefined or non-finite (zero denominator, missing evaluation, empty stratum), classify NULL; any comparison with any NULL seed is inconclusive, neither passed nor falsified. Never impute or drop that seed.

hyperbolic_necessity: Negative curvature is motivated by a branching neighborhood: negatively curved space can expand neighborhood capacity with radius, potentially separating successor branches under a fixed-depth hierarchy. Strong train-only directionality and successor entropy motivate testing this; neither measurements nor literature establish necessity. The cited generative semantic-ID work supports semantic-ID recommendation only; supplied hyperbolic overlap is unverified.
euclidean_control: Identical c-parameterized implementation, at c=0.1 versus c=0. Same P_R, model, code parameters, assignments, residual updates, train-only transition signal, objective, initialization, optimizer, schedule, seeds, and budget. Only scored squared distance changes to its exact c->0 limit; no curvature-dependent representation map exists.
effect_site: Stage2 assignment and reconstruction/commitment geometry, with leading indicators L3 collision, L3 refinement gain, conditional G3, and prefix diversity; Stage3 T5 ranking is the behavioral endpoint.
real_trigger_measurement: Train-only longest-prefix evidence: directed_pairs=323633, transitions=339519, no_observed_reverse_events=314605, no_reverse_fraction=0.9266197178950221, mean_next_item_entropy_bits=4.844072338042215. Descriptive, not causal.
training_only_inputs: Stage2 uses item content embeddings and adjacent train-split transitions only. No validation/test behavior, future event, prediction-time user context, or batch composition enters fitting, targets, assignments, or global SID creation. Validation is diagnostic-only; test interactions are Stage3 evaluation-only.

protocol.batch_size: frozen existing Stage2 batch size, unchanged between arms
protocol.optimizer_schedule: frozen existing Stage2 optimizer and schedule, unchanged between arms
protocol.seeds: frozen existing Stage2 seed set, paired identically
protocol.codebook_initialization: frozen existing Stage2 codebook initialization, identical paired initialization

stage2_diagnostics.name: valid_l1_hard_er
stage2_diagnostics.direction: curved > flat and curved strictly above frozen Resample reference
stage2_diagnostics.minimum_effect: curved value strictly greater than frozen Resample reference
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: For each paired frozen seed compute curved-minus-flat and require every difference >0; equal-weight arithmetic mean of curved seed values must be strictly above the frozen Resample reference.

stage2_diagnostics.name: level2_distinct_prefixes
stage2_diagnostics.direction: curved > flat and curved strictly above frozen threshold
stage2_diagnostics.minimum_effect: curved value strictly greater than the frozen distinct-prefix threshold
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: For each paired frozen seed compute curved-minus-flat and require every difference >0; equal-weight arithmetic mean of curved seed values must be strictly above the frozen distinct-prefix threshold.

stage2_diagnostics.name: L3 collision
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: Compute flat-minus-curved per paired seed; every difference >0 and unweighted arithmetic mean >=0.01.

stage2_diagnostics.name: L3 refinement gain
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: Compute curved-minus-flat per paired seed; every difference >0 and unweighted arithmetic mean >=0.10 bits.

stage2_diagnostics.name: conditional G3
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: Compute curved-minus-flat per paired seed using frozen estimator; every difference >0 and unweighted arithmetic mean >=0.05 bits.

stage3_behavioral_test.seed_rule: On identical paired seeds compute curved test_R@10 minus flat test_R@10 per seed; take the equal-weight arithmetic mean of these paired differences and require it to meet the registered minimum_effect. No metric substitution.

classification.falsified_if: Any registered diagnostic or Stage3 test has a defined aggregate opposite its registered direction or fails its registered minimum_effect.
classification.passed_if: All five registered Stage2 diagnostics and the Stage3 test satisfy their registered direction and minimum_effect, with no NULL seed.
classification.mixed_if: At least one Stage2 diagnostic satisfies its registered direction and minimum_effect and at least one registered Stage2 diagnostic or Stage3 test fails its registered direction or minimum_effect, with no NULL seed.
